mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies and a temperature of 41 degrees at Badger Prairie County Park, under the glow of a waxing crescent moon.

The city is currently preparing for the 2027 Spring Election, and candidate packets are available at the City Clerk office for those interested in running for an Aldermanic district seat. Additionally, the city is continuing its infrastructure projects, including the paving of the Military Ridge State Trail to improve accessibility.

We have a busy schedule ahead. Today you can enjoy Yoga at Insight Wellness or check out the activities at ART House 360. Tomorrow, look forward to live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company.
On October 25, officers responded to the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue where they found a driver who had been stopped for over 20 minutes, leading to an arrest for an O W I.
Culver's of Verona is serving up the delicious Devil's Food Cake as the flavor of the day, and they open their doors today at 10:00 AM.
